acceptanceCriteria: A Git process that hangs while the repository is opened produces `INVALID` with gap `git-timeout`, not `invalid-repository`, covered by a test with a fake hanging git.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-1/wave-2 pull requests (#74-#82). Review of PR #78 (V1-0008): GENESIS-025 names `git-timeout` for hangs after open; a hang during open is misreported.

completion.reason: Stale: every acceptance criterion is already met on origin/main (verified at a5aeee41). Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-06-stale-ticket-closure.md at 5a7045a537610b0afe2117428c8268c5d938c074 (PR beamfall/corvint#629), row V1-0124: commit b58dbe3b; AC1: internal/genesis/repository.go:70 preserves git-timeout; activation_fallback_test.go:81 uses hanging Git and asserts INVALID/git-timeout. Read-only independent verification (Codex batch C) plus mechanical check of cited commits, tests and paths; no suite rerun for this closure.

title: genesis: a Git hang during repository open yields `invalid-repository` instead of `git-timeout`
